# noderings_virtual_machine_snapshots (Data Source)

**Experimental.** Lists a virtual machine's snapshots, newest first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "noderings_virtual_machine_snapshots" "web" {
  virtual_machine_id = noderings_virtual_machine.web.id
}

output "snapshots" {
  value = data.noderings_virtual_machine_snapshots.web.snapshots[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `virtual_machine_id` (String) ID of the virtual machine.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) Snapshots. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Snapshot ID.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `operation_status` (String) `pending`, `processing`, `completed` or `failed`.
- `restore_status` (String) State of the last restore from this snapshot.
- `status` (String) `active`, `deleted` or `expired`.
